title: Concept: Archive extraction via $zip->extractTo (php) — review required
description: In php, $zip->extractTo writes archive members to the filesystem. Entry names are attacker-controlled metadata in hostile archives, so extraction without name checks is a write primitive. The remedy is per-entry validation via entry-name validation before write.
applicability: php codebases extracting archives through $zip->extractTo; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file overwrite (Zip Slip) from hostile archives; HIGH severity because archives routinely cross trust boundaries.
